main_body: two stacked horizontal firewood logs with cut ends on the left and bark cylinders extending to the right
top_band: light brown upper cylinder highlight on the top log at row 4 (and row 10 on the lower log), with cylindrical shading stepping down into mid and dark brown on rows 5-8 and 11-12
evidence: Two stacked horizontal logs seen in 3/4 view: the upper log runs rows 3-8 with a top highlight band at row 4-5 and shaded lower front face at rows 6-8 casting a shadow (row 9) onto the lower, slightly forward-offset log (rows 9-13). style.evidence: The logs use 5 distinct steps on the cut wood ends (cream highlight to warm tan and medium brown heartwood dot) and 4-5 steps on the bark (warm highlight, mid brown, dark brown, deep brown outline). Outlines are a dark brown material tone, and the small prop has good pixel-level grain and ring detail comparable to Beodeul small props.
